records.query: Microsoft 最新一季整體營業利益成長多少？主要由哪些部門帶動？
records.answer:
Microsoft 在最新一季（截至 2026 年 3 月 31 日的三個月）整體營業利益增加了 **64 億美元（$6.4 十億）**，成長 **20%**，主要由 **Productivity and Business Processes** 與 **Intelligent Cloud** 兩大部門的成長所帶動【MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #63】。  

- 其中，Productivity and Business Processes 部門的營業利益單季亦提升 **36 億美元（$3.6 十億）**，增幅 **21%**【MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #68】。  

因此，最新一季的營業利益成長主要來源於這兩個核心雲端與生產力服務部門的營收與毛利提升。

records.query: Google 收購 Wiz 花了多少錢？這如何影響 Google Cloud 部門？
records.answer:
Google 以 **295 億美元（$29.5 billion）** 完成了對 Wiz 的收購，收購完成後相關財務結果已併入 Google Cloud 部門【GOOGL_10Q_202606.html, chunk #67】。  

- 收購價格分配如下（以百萬美元計）：無形資產 **$8,300**、商譽 **$22,705**、承擔的淨負債 **$(1,538)**，合計購買價格 **$29,467**（即約 **295 億美元（$29.5 billion）**）【GOOGL_10Q_202606.html, chunk #67】。  
- 商譽已記錄在 Google Cloud 部門，主要歸因於預期的協同效應，且不具稅務可抵扣性【GOOGL_10Q_202606.html, chunk #67】。  
- 收購完成後，Wiz 的營運結果已被納入合併財務報表，並歸屬於 Google Cloud 事業部【GOOGL_10Q_202603.html, chunk #50】、【GOOGL_10Q_202603.html, chunk #126】。  

因此，這筆 **295 億美元（$29.5 billion）** 的投資直接擴大了 Google Cloud 的資產基礎與未來的 AI‑驅動安全能力，同時在財務層面提升了該部門的無形資產與商譽規模。

Productivity and Business Processes

Microsoft 365 Commercial products revenue grew 10% driven by an increase in Office 2024 transactional purchasing, as well as growth in the Windows Commercial on-premises components of Microsoft 365 suite sales. •Microsoft 365 Consumer products and cloud services revenue increased $1.4 billion or 27%. [MSFT 10-Q period 202603] [Three Months Ended March 31, 2026 vs March 31, 2025] [section: Productivity and Business Processes] Three Months Ended March 31, 2026 Compared with Three Months Ended March 31, 2025

Productivity and Business Processes

Revenue increased $5.1 billion or 17%. •Microsoft 365 Commercial products and cloud services revenue increased $3.7 billion or 17%. Microsoft 365 Commercial cloud revenue grew 19% with growth in revenue per user driven by Microsoft 365 E5 and Microsoft 365 Copilot. Microsoft 365 Commercial seats grew 6% driven by small and medium businesses and frontline worker offerings. Microsoft 365 Commercial products revenue grew 1%. •Microsoft 365 Consumer products and cloud services revenue increased $476 million or 26%. Operating income increased $3.6 billion or 21%. •Cost of revenue increased $680 million or 12% driven by investments in AI infrastructure to support Microsoft 365 Copilot seat and usage growth. •Gross margin increased $4.4 billion or 18% driven by growth in Microsoft 365 Commercial cloud.
